pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

$BOW is the Credit Layer for Robinhood Chain. That’s a thesis worth paying attention to. 🏹 Longbow lets holders borrow against tokenized stocks, crypto and RWAs without selling their positions. Lenders earn interest. Borrowers unlock capital. Real financial demand, with Morpho Blue handling settlement. (longbow.finance)

The platform reports 74 live markets and roughly $4.4M supplied. And here’s the part that matters for $BOW: staking earns USDG from protocol revenue, connecting the token to the business being built. (longbow.finance)

My bull case is simple: more assets on Robinhood Chain means a bigger potential collateral market. More borrowing could mean more revenue—and a stronger reason to stake BOW.

Tokenized stocks are the opening. Credit is what puts that capital to work.

That’s why I’m so fucking bullish on $BOW.

comment.comment:
My thesis on BOW is pretty simple: 

> The big winners of a new ecosystems/chains are usually the foundational infra plays that many are currently overlooking as they are so focused on memes and making a quick flip 

> BOW is the credit layer for Robinhood Chain -  the protocol that turns tokenized stocks, RWAs, crypto, and memes into borrowable collateral instead of dead inventory - think of it as them trying to be what Kamino is on SOL but for Robinhood Chain 

> The native TVL on BOW is still relatively little, which is normal as its a nascent protocol with around 4-5m TVL. Watching the TVL increase closely, if this continues to grow and attract liquidity the price of BOW should naturally increase as well 

> Team is doxxed and actively hired some top crypto talent which is a great sign - most of the teams right now are fully anon and you don't have any insights into them building a real business
